## 3. Runtime and constraints

Compiled by `pyc.py` for `py_core`; only this subset is allowed (anything else is rejected at compile time):

```text
ints, True/False/None, names, + - & | ^ << >> ~ unary -, not/and/or
  in conditions, one comparison per expression (< <= > >= == !=),
  mem32[addr] loads/stores (also mem32[a] op= v), name op= expr,
  if/elif/else, while/break/continue, pass, global, import (ignored).
  "from <name> import *" where <name>.py sits next to the source file
  inlines that file there (once), so firmware can be split into modules
  that share one global namespace; errors name the original file / line.
  Without such a file, "from <name> import *" reads the SystemVerilog
  package <name>.sv found next to the source or in a -I directory (the
  memory map packages, e.g. video_processor_map_pkg.sv): its
  "localparam ... NAME = expr;" lines become UPPER_CASE constants NAME
  (folded), "import <pkg>::*;" loads that package first, <pkg>::NAME and
  SV literals (32'h0001_0000, 'h40, 16'd10) are understood, so the
  firmware takes its addresses from the same file as the RTL decoders.
  UPPER_CASE module-level names bound once to a constant expression
  (or const(expr)) are folded at compile time.
  def f(a, b): ... return x   functions with positional parameters,
  called as f(x, y) in expressions or statements; recursion is allowed
  up to the core's call depth. Missing return -> None.
  A function passed to irq_handler() is an interrupt handler instead:
  no parameters, no return value, cannot be called directly.
Builtins: irq_handler(fn), irq_enable(), irq_disable(), wait_irq(), halt(value).
  wait_irq() (WAIT_IRQ, 0x3E) stops the core until its interrupt input is high (an enabled
  source pending at the intc), whether interrupts are enabled or not; with them disabled the
  code after it runs first (the race-free sleep: disable, test, wait_irq, enable).
Strings: a string literal (in any expression, e.g. puts("text")) is a
  small int handle; the text goes to a string table in flash at
  STR_BASE (0x8000), outside the boot image, for the firmware to read at
  run time through the flash controller. The table has 512 slots of 64
  bytes (0x8000-0xFFFF): [0] length (0..62), [1] 1 if the string
  continues in the next slot, [2..] the bytes. A handle is the first slot
  number; slots 128..255 are emitted as h - 256 so they fit LOAD_SMALL,
  slots 256..511 as h (a constant). Firmware decodes a handle with
  slot = h if h >= 256 else h & 255.
  strings("a", "b", ...) returns the handle of a block of consecutive
  one-slot strings (each <= 62 bytes), so handle + i selects entry i (a
  block never straddles slot 256, so the decoding holds for handle + i).
  Identical strings share slots.
Not in the hardware fast path (rejected): * / % ** on variables (py_core v1),
** always, default/keyword arguments, closures, lists, dicts, floats, classes.
--core 2 (py_core v2): * // % on variables (BINARY_MUL 0x17, BINARY_FLOORDIV
  0x1E, BINARY_MOD 0x1F: Python's floor division and modulo, a zero
  divisor traps), 256 globals and 32 locals per function.
```

- Register addresses come from the SystemVerilog map packages (`from <pkg> import *`), never hard-coded numbers, so firmware and RTL decoders share one source.
- Every hardware wait has a bound (poll count) and reports a timeout instead of hanging.

## 5. Requirements traceability

- Every register access must match the register map of the block it addresses (its `<ip>/docs/<ip>_prompt.md` section 5/6 and `src/include/<ip>_regs.json`): offset, access type (RO / RW / W1C / CMD), bit fields and reset values.
- Behaviour described below and not covered by a requirement is reported in the review.

## 6. Function

Implement exactly this behaviour (from the reference program's documentation):

```text
video_processor firmware: the NPU detector and a ByteTrack-type multi-object tracker (py_core v2).

The NPU (registers at NPU, golden model ip/ai/npu/model/npu_model.py) runs the compiled detector (YOLOv8s by default, 80 COCO
classes) on every frame its frame writer stores in DDR and leaves a list of detections there (16 bytes
each: x0 | x1 << 16, y0 | y1 << 16, class | score << 8, in frame pixels; score 0-255). Its program is
preloaded in DDR; a header at NPU_HDR gives the descriptor address, the network input size (width x
height) and that of a second, low-resolution pass for large objects (0: none; its letterbox in LB2_*,
set by npu_setup). On every tracker event (frame_counter channel 4: the NPU's results are ready) bt_event():
  1. reads the detections through the CPU's DDR window, keeps the classes selected (det_mask, by group);
  2. (non-maximum suppression and the foreground-first order are the NPU's: NMS operation) a backpack,
     umbrella, handbag, tie or suitcase inside a person is part of the person (suppressed);
  3. predicts every track (steady-state Kalman filter: position and size with velocity, alpha 3/4, beta 1/4
     for the position and 1/8 for the size: shifts and one multiply, no matrices);
  4. associates as ByteTrack (Zhang et al., ECCV 2022; thresholds of Ultralytics' bytetrack.yaml): tracked
     and lost tracks with the high-score detections (score 0.25+, IoU x score 0.2+), the tracks still
     unmatched with the low-score ones (0.1-0.25, IoU 0.5+), the tentative tracks with the rest of the high
     ones (IoU x score 0.3+); association is greedy by the highest value, a match across groups counting
     half (ByteTrack uses the Hungarian algorithm; greedy is its usual embedded stand-in);
  5. two tracks of a group overlapping by more than 0.4 for 3 frames in a row are one object (the
     detector's two boxes for it): the younger is dropped; a strong detection left over that overlaps a
     lost track revives it, one that overlaps a matched track (IoU 0.5+) is a duplicate and dropped;
     unmatched tentative tracks are dropped, unmatched tracked ones become lost (their velocity slowing
     by a quarter per frame) and are kept TRACK_BUFFER frames for re-identification; unmatched high
     detections (0.25+) start tentative tracks, confirmed by a second match; a track's class follows its
     detections by vote (VOTE_MAX), so an odd detection of another class does not change it;
  6. draws every confirmed track matched this frame or lost for at most COAST_SHOW frames (at its
     predicted position, while inside the frame and not over a matched track of its group: coast_shown): overlay object k = track k (32: two overlay banks), the group's symbol and
     colour (P person: white box with corners; G ground transport: red box with ticks; A aircraft: green
     triangle; O any other object: yellow box with corners) and its label (group letter and the lowest
     number free in the group) below it, at the box centre (the symbol's size scales with the frame:
     mark_half, overlay.symbol_scale).
State lives in the data RAM (RAM): tracks (16 words each), detections (8 words each), the IoU table.
```

Per function:

```text
sread: Signed word of the data RAM (mem32 reads it unsigned).

group: Overlay group of COCO class c: 0 person, 1 ground transport, 2 aircraft, 3 any other object.

group_on: The camera's class selection (det_mask) by group: other objects with every class selected.

group_class: The firmware class whose symbol style the group uses (camera registers 0x51-0x55).

npu_present: 1 when the NPU answers and its program is in DDR.

fit: The frame's letterbox in an nw x nh network input (integer arithmetic, as the compiler's geometry()):
its size into lb_sw, lb_sh.

npu_setup: NPU for the sequence's frame size: frame writer, letterbox of each pass, detection list, automatic
runs; every track free.

iou: Intersection over union of two boxes (inclusive pixels), per mille.

cover: Intersection over the smaller box's area (inclusive pixels), per mille.

read_dets: The NPU's detections of the selected groups into the data RAM; their count.

drop_accessories: A backpack, umbrella, handbag, tie or suitcase (COCO 24-28) whose centre lies in a person's box is
part of that person: suppressed (not a target of its own).

predict: Every live track moved by its velocity; its IoU with every detection into I_RAM; no match yet.

associate: Greedy association: tracks in state sa or sb without a match, detections unused, not suppressed,
with a score in smin .. smax - 1, of any class (as Ultralytics' ByteTrack; the track's class follows
its detections by vote): the pair with the highest IoU (fuse: IoU x score, ByteTrack's fuse_score)
of imin or more first, until none is left.

update: Track k with detection i: alpha-beta (steady-state Kalman) update of centre, size and velocities.

start: A tentative track k at detection i, at rest.

label_num: The number of a label word (1-32; 0: none): one digit, or tens then units.

label: Label word of track k: its group letter and the lowest number no other confirmed track of the
group has (1-32: one or two digits; the used numbers kept as bits 1-31 of one word).

confirmed: Confirmed tracks (tracked or lost).

bt_event: One frame: detections, NMS, prediction, ByteTrack association, track life cycle, overlay, the
transcript's part of the line.

merge: Duplicate tracks of one object (the detector's two boxes for it), two tracks of a group, both
tracked, for MERGE_FRAMES frames in a row: overlapping by more than MERGE_IOU, the younger (fewer hits;
on a tie the higher slot) is dropped; or the smaller overlapping by more than MERGE_COVER of its box
and a quarter of the other's area or more (a part box: a person cut by the frame's edge and their upper
body; aircraft any size: the parts of a large aircraft), the smaller is dropped. A distant person or
car behind a near one is usually under a quarter of its size and stays.

overlap: A track that detection i belongs to: a track matched this frame that it overlaps by more than half
(a duplicate), or a lost one it overlaps (IoU 0.1+, the best); -1 when none.

free_slot: A free track for detection i; when none is free (or the most targets are confirmed), the smallest
track if detection i is at least twice its area (foreground before background); else -1.

coast_shown: A lost track k is drawn while coasting: its predicted centre inside the frame (not an object that
has left: its symbol would be clamped onto whatever is at the edge) and not overlapping a track of its
group matched this frame by more than COAST_COVER of the smaller box (the same object, or one hidden
behind it).

bt_draw: Overlay object k for track k (confirmed: matched this frame or coasting at most COAST_SHOW frames),
its part of the transcript line.
```
